document.abstract: This report supplements the report of May 15, 1936, of the Scientific Committee of the Research Council of the Academy of Motion Picture Arts & Sciences. Developments since the appearance of the first report are traced briefly, specific reference being made to the recent British experiment and other developments abroad, as well as to the field-tests now being conducted in America.
